successors.name: Spanish Empire
successors.text: Zaculeu, 'the capital of the Postclassic Mam kingdom', beside Huehuetenango; the pages give no extent

ledger.x: Postclassic (page: 'AD 900-1200' Early, '1200-1525' Late): 'Zaculeu was the capital of the Postclassic Mam kingdom'; the page gives no founding year, so 900 is the start of the Postclassic, a bridge.

15th century: the K'iche' conquest of the Mam kingdoms, 'traditionally ... calculated as during the 15th century AD' (the page also allows 'as early as the 12th century'); the infobox lists 'Conquered by: K'iche' Kingdom of Q'umarkaj'.
March 1524: the K'iche' kingdom ends with the burning of Q'umarkaj; the pages do not say the Mam were freed, but the Spanish later fight them at Zaculeu as the Mam capital in 1525.
July 1525: 'Gonzalo de Alvarado left the Spanish camp at Tecpán Guatemala in July 1525' against Zaculeu; 'After a siege lasting several months, the Mam were reduced to starvation' (Zaculeu page).
October 1525: 'Kaybʼil Bʼalam finally surrendered the city to the Spanish in the middle of October 1525' (the Zaculeu page: 'in October 1525').
October 1525: Zaculeu falls to the Spanish.
October 1525: the Mam kingdom ends with the surrender of Zaculeu (infobox 'Abandoned: 1525').

wars.name: Siege of Zaculeu
wars.outcome: Gonzalo de Alvarado left Tecpán in July 1525; Kayb'il B'alam surrendered the Mam capital in the middle of October 1525 after a siege of 'several months'.
